summary: End-to-end verification of the Sathi AI companion flow. Patient login (DEMO01/1234) succeeded, Sathi modal opened, three sequential messages ('Tell me about my family', 'I feel a little bored', 'where am I, I am scared') each produced HTTP 200 responses from POST /api/sathi/chat with unique, contextual, Groq-generated replies rendered in the modal. The distress guardrail correctly returned distress_flagged=true for the 'scared' message and the caregiver-notified banner appeared. No static fallback was observed. The user-reported bug 'the voice assistant doesn't respond, like the API doesn't work' is NOT reproducible — Sathi is fully functional end-to-end via the public preview URL.
critical_code_review_comments: SathiModal.handleSendMessage falls back to a hard-coded static bubble on any exception (lines 91-107). Consider surfacing a subtle retry hint so real backend errors are debuggable in production instead of masked as a scripted reply.

Frontend api.js uses `import.meta.env.VITE_BACKEND_URL || '/api'`. Note the platform-standard `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL` (documented in system env) is NOT used; the app relies on Vite's same-origin proxy. This works via the preview URL but will break in any deployment lacking the /api proxy — worth documenting for main agent.
seed_data_creation: None; used seeded Promod Baruah demo patient.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sathi chat is confirmed working via Groq at POST /api/sathi/chat. Public URL is https://5d7fb6f6-598b-439e-960d-904c17095bab.preview.emergentagent.com. Verified 3 turns with distinct dynamic replies plus distress guardrail (distress_flagged=true + caregiver-notified banner). Auth flow used demo autofill button.
rca of the issue: Original user report was caused by the previous supervisor misconfiguration (uvicorn could not import module 'server'). Main agent's fix — adding /app/backend/server.py shim re-exporting app.main:app, adding vite 'start' script, and vite proxy pointing to 127.0.0.1:8001 — resolved it. Backend supervisor now RUNNING (pid confirmed), frontend RUNNING, and /api/sathi/chat returns 200 with Groq-generated JSON.
